title: Sizing the second compost bin
summary: Where a second compost bin fits behind the shared beds and how big it must be to leave room for the wheelbarrow.

# Sizing the second compost bin

A second compost bin would sit best at the end of the gravel path, behind the
tool rack, where the ground is level and the afternoon shade keeps the pile from
drying out. It needs a footprint of about one metre square so it can be turned
with a fork, and a clear gap of at least seventy centimetres beside it so the
wheelbarrow can still get past. Slatted pallet sides would let air in, and a
hinged front board would make emptying it easier. Whoever builds it should
check the gap with the wheelbarrow loaded before fixing the posts.
